parsed.rationale: The rhythm is irregularly irregular with no clear P waves and a fibrillatory baseline. The QRS is narrow, and the voltages are very large (deep S in V1–V3, tall R in V5–V6) with lateral strain. The ST elevation in V1–V3 is discordant to the deep S waves, so it is a voltage/repolarisation effect and not STEMI.
